summary: This directory orchestrates the end-to-end pipeline for automated documentation generation. It manages the assembly of project context, the loading of prompt templates, and the execution of generation tasks to produce structured and validated README content.
responsibilities: Orchestrate the generation process for README documentation sections
Assemble project data into structured prompts for model processing
Resolve and load modular prompt templates from the filesystem
Execute and validate the construction of documentation components
relationships: The renderer consumes project context to build specific prompts defined by the prompt loader.
The executor runs the pipeline assembly tasks and utilizes test suites to validate that the generated section items meet structural requirements.
designDecisions: Registry pattern for associating section identifiers with generation strategies
Encapsulation of file loading logic through factory functions
Collocation of test suites with core logic components
